changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO user_consent (user_id, consent_type, document_version, accepted_at, ip_address, user_agent) SELECT user_id, consent_type, '1.0', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, '127.0.0.1', 'HandyNest dev seed' FROM ( SELECT id AS user_id FROM handy_user WHERE email IN ('customer@handynest.dev', 'performer@handynest.dev', 'admin@handynest.dev') ) users CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('TERMS_OF_SERVICE'), ('PRIVACY_POLICY'), ('PERSONAL_DATA_PROCESSING'), ('PERFORMER_RULES'), ('CUSTOMER_RULES'), ('PROHIBITED_SERVICES_POLICY'), ('PAYMENT_POLICY') ) types(consent_type) ON CONFLICT (user_id, consent_type, document_version) DO NOTHING;
